action.objective: They took back the centre with e5 and d4 is lost; develop the bishop to e2, shield the king, and prepare to contest the passed central pawns.
action.rationale: Verified single-candidate f1e2: depth-4 probe completed with exact score +25, safety.complete=true, no mate-in-one reply, tactical_refutation not_found. move_facts confirm the bishop is developed off f1 and no new capture threats appear beyond pre-existing Black captures of loose b4/d4/d3/a2 units. Black's last move e6e5 grabbed the centre; my b4 and d4 pawns are under pressure, but no verified alternative gains material without broader search (analysis_nodes_available=0), and all other broad candidates were upper-bound/unverified. Be2 develops the last minor, connects rooks toward castling ideas and keeps a threat on c4-area dark squares while avoiding a king-side weakening.
